routePlanning.title: The best route — automatically
routePlanning.subtitle: From your service addresses, Klacks works out the most sensible order and shows the finished route on the map. All you choose is the mode of transport.
routePlanning.step1Text: Every service location has an address on file — Klacks knows the way.
routePlanning.step2Text: Klacks works out the shortest sensible sequence — detours and empty runs disappear.
routePlanning.step3Text: The finished route appears on the map — by car, bike, or on foot.
routePlanning.mapCaption: Stylized example: Klacks connects the service locations into the shortest route.
